headline: Washington Signals $48 Billion Financial Backing Package for Milei Government
summary: U.S. officials indicated ongoing commitment to support Argentina's government regardless of midterm results, pointing to $30 billion available for investment projects and an $18 billion currency swap facility to counter Chinese influence.
why: External financing facilities and currency swaps are pivotal for Argentina to build foreign reserves, normalize external debt commitments, and remove foreign exchange restrictions.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Potential US-backed credit lines and project funding improve foreign reserve stability and external liquidity.
